- Campaign Cleaner connector skill for managing email campaign analysis through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Supports listing campaigns, retrieving full campaign payloads, checking processing status, and downloading PDF analysis reports.
- Adds write support for submitting email campaign HTML for Campaign Cleaner processing.
- Includes credit balance lookup for the connected Campaign Cleaner API key.
- Documents safety handling for write and destructive actions, including confirmation before campaign submission or deletion.
